response.sql: WITH race_stats AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.name AS race_name, AVG(cr.points) AS average_points, COUNT(*) AS result_count FROM races AS r JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId WHERE cr.points >= 1.0 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name), ratios AS (SELECT raceId, race_name, average_points, result_count, average_points / AVG(average_points) OVER (PARTITION BY race_name) AS ratio FROM race_stats) SELECT raceId, race_name, average_points, result_count, ratio FROM ratios ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC, raceId LIMIT 10;
